# LuaSPortFrame

`LuaSPortFrame` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `frame:band()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`band()`](band.md) | Get / Set the band. | 1.1.0 |
| [`rx()`](rx.md) | Get / Set the rx index. | 1.1.0 |
| [`physId()`](physId.md) | Get / Set the physId of the frame. | 1.1.0 |
| [`primId()`](primId.md) | Get / Set the primId of the frame. | 1.1.0 |
| [`appId()`](appId.md) | Get / Set the appId of the frame. | 1.1.0 |
| [`value()`](value.md) | Get / Set the value of the frame. | 1.1.0 |
